# ClientSortNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.ClientSortNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Materializes all input rows, sorts them by the specified ORDER BY items, then yields the sorted results. Used for client-side joins where FetchXML cannot provide server-side sorting.
